name: Nitrogen
deficiency_symptoms: Stunted growth, pale yellow older leaves

name: Phosphorus
deficiency_symptoms: Purple leaves, poor tillering, delayed maturity

name: Potassium
deficiency_symptoms: Scorched leaf margins, weak stem, lodging

name: Zinc
deficiency_symptoms: Khaira in rice (white bud), small leaves, interveinal chlorosis

name: Copper
deficiency_symptoms: Die-back of shoots, leaf tip necrosis

name: Boron
deficiency_symptoms: Distorted growth, hollow stem, fruit cracking
